A partial snapshot would be one where some of the shards were snapshotted and others weren't. If we take a snapshot with `partial: true` while the index is red (say it had two primaries and one were unavailable) that would cause a partial snapshot.

It would probably be good to test this as well, since we test it for regular system indices.
